fullPassage:
[1번] The Faroe Islands are a group of islands in the North Atlantic. Although they are controlled by Denmark, they have their own government. The people of the islands traditionally hunt pilot whales. They have done this for centuries, so whale meat and blubber are important parts of the local diet. The government insists the killing of whales is not done for profit. Most of the whale meat and blubber is distributed for free to the local community, although some is sold in supermarkets. Multiple hunts are held each year under the strict supervision of the local government. There is a law that says each killing must take place as quickly and efficiently as possible. The government claims that the average annual catch is only about 800 whales and that this is a small percentage of the overall pilot whale population. However, environmental groups still question whether this practice should be allowed to continue.

[2번] Broken heart syndrome, also known as takotsubo syndrome (TTS), is a condition that occurs when stress weakens the heart's ability to pump blood. TTS can occur after stressful events such as the loss of a family member or a natural disaster. Surprisingly, researchers say people can also get TTS when happy things occur, sometimes referring to this as "happy heart syndrome." A researcher discovered this while analyzing data from 1,750 patients with takotsubo syndrome. Of the 485 patients diagnosed after emotional events, 20 had experienced happy events. The researcher concluded that the brain reacts similarly to extremely positive and negative events, so both can result in takotsubo syndrome.

[3번] Imagine you take your bicycle to a repair shop. You expect the workers at the shop to do what you paid them to do, which is to fix your bicycle. If they do a good job, you will be back again next time for bike repairs. If they do a bad job, however, you will look for a new repair shop. The same is true with governments. It is our job as citizens to make sure that government does what is expected. If they do a good job, we can trust them in the future. If they don't, we can explain why we won't vote for them again. This kind of participation in government is important. How much effort we put into participating depends on how well we think the government is doing. If we are satisfied, we will do very little besides voting. But if we are dissatisfied, we will probably take other types of action.

[4번] Dr. Viktor Emil Frankl was an Austrian psychiatrist who thought that feeling emotional pain was a natural part of life, and that humans have the ability to choose how to respond to situations. But most importantly, he believed that people's main motivation in life is the search for meaning. According to Frankl, in order to find this meaning in their lives, people have to change their attitude toward unavoidable suffering. For example, Frankl was helping a man who was severely depressed after his wife's death. He asked the man to think about what would have happened if he had died first and his wife had been forced to live without him. The man realized his own grief and pain meant that his wife did not have to experience what he was going through. This helped end his depression.

[5번] Many products for sale at local supermarkets contain a chemical called bisphenol A, more commonly known as BPA. BPA can be found in plastics used to make food containers and baby bottles. It is also used to protect the inside of metal food cans. These products can cause people to be exposed to BPA through their diet. This is because BPA may leak out of these containers and into the food itself. BPA is harmful to the body because its structure is similar to that of natural hormones. This similarity makes it easy for vital bodily functions to be negatively affected. Whether or not BPA should be banned is controversial, but many experts consider it unwise to use products that contain BPA.

[6번] When we experience feelings of fatigue, they may seem to be physical. Yet, studies show that these feelings don't actually come from the body. Even when people report being exhausted from exercise, there is still enough energy in their muscle tissues to continue on for several minutes more. This is because it is actually the brain that sends us the message to stop exercising before we reach our physical limit in order to prevent potential injuries. However, scientists have found it possible to fool the brain. For example, running a small electrical current through their brain increased cyclists' output by 10%. And other athletes have shown improvements in their performance in hot conditions when given incorrect information about the temperature.

[7번] In today's interconnected world, people rely heavily on a handful of dominant languages. This causes a serious problem, even though it improves international cooperation, by threatening vulnerable languages. Many languages slowly die out as the younger generations first become bilingual and then gradually abandon their traditional language. It is important that efforts are made to prevent this from happening. Language is woven together with culture, and it reflects what is important to those who speak it. As a culture develops, its language grows and changes with it. But when a language is lost, the culture is at risk. Without a language to pass down stories and lessons from the past, the culture could simply disappear.

[8번] The concept of karma suggests that every action has a consequence, whether in this life or the next. Essentially, karma is like a seed; what you plant, you will eventually harvest. For example, a man kept harassing others online under the cloak of anonymity. Eventually, however, his identity was exposed and legal action was taken against him. In a different instance, a CEO of a large company paid the necessary, expensive fees to dispose of waste from its factory correctly, while her rivals simply dumped their waste from their factories into local rivers. A government investigation later revealed the behavior of her competitors. They were forced to pay massive fines and eventually went bankrupt. These examples remind us that living a moral life matters, even if we don't immediately see the results of our actions.

det.korean: powerful → vulnerable: 지배적 언어에 의해 위협받는 것은 '취약한(vulnerable)' 언어이지 '강력한(powerful)' 언어가 아님
det.analysis:
❌ ① powerful — 소수의 지배적 언어에 대한 의존이 위협하는 대상은 힘없고 '취약한(vulnerable)' 언어예요. '강력한(powerful)' 언어라고 하면 위협의 대상으로 맞지 않아요 ←정답

✅ ② bilingual — 젊은 세대가 2개 국어를 쓰게 된다, 적절해요.

✅ ③ woven — 언어가 문화와 엮여 있다, 적절해요.

✅ ④ disappear — 언어 없이 문화가 사라질 수 있다, 적절해요.
det.tip: 위협받는 것은 vulnerable(취약한) 언어. powerful(강력한)은 반대

questions.passage: The concept of karma suggests that every action has a consequence, whether in this life or the next. Essentially, karma is like a seed; what you plant, you will eventually harvest. For example, a man kept ①<u>harassing</u> others online under the cloak of anonymity. Eventually, however, his identity was ②<u>exposed</u> and legal action was taken against him. In a different instance, a CEO of a large company paid the necessary, expensive fees to dispose of waste from its factory correctly, while her rivals simply ③<u>dumping</u> their waste from their factories into local rivers. A government investigation later revealed the behavior of her competitors. They were ④<u>forced</u> to pay massive fines and eventually went bankrupt. These examples remind us that living a moral life matters, even if we don't immediately see the results of our actions.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ dumping → dumped: while절 안의 주어(her rivals)에 딸린 진짜 동사 자리라, -ing가 아니라 과거시제 dumped
det.analysis:
✅ ① harassing — 'a man kept ① harassing others(한 남자가 계속 남을 괴롭혔다)'에서 keep 뒤에는 동사-ing를 써요. keep harassing(계속 괴롭히다), 적절해요.

✅ ② exposed — 'his identity was ② exposed(그의 신원이 드러났다)'는 be동사 뒤 과거분사로 수동태예요, 적절해요.

❌ ③ dumping — 'while her rivals simply ③ dumping their waste(반면 그녀의 경쟁사들은 그저 폐기물을 버렸다)'는 while(~하는 반면)로 시작하는 절이에요. 이 절에도 주어(her rivals)에 맞는 진짜 동사가 필요해요. 앞의 paid(과거)와 짝을 이루도록 과거시제 dumped가 맞아요. -ing형 dumping은 동사 역할을 못 해 틀려요 ←정답

✅ ④ forced — 'They were ④ forced to pay(내도록 강요받았다)'는 수동태로 적절해요.
det.tip: while + 주어 + 동사: 절 안에는 -ing가 아니라 시제를 가진 진짜 동사(dumped)가 필요

questions.passage: The Faroe Islands are a group of islands in the North Atlantic. Although they are controlled by Denmark, they have their own government. The people of the islands traditionally hunt pilot whales. They have done this for centuries, so whale meat and blubber are important parts of the local diet. The government insists the killing of whales is not done for profit. Most of the whale meat and blubber is distributed __________ to the local community, although some is sold in supermarkets. Multiple hunts are held each year under the strict supervision of the local government. There is a law that says each killing must take place as quickly and efficiently as possible. The government claims that the average annual catch is only about 800 whales and that this is a small percentage of the overall pilot whale population. However, environmental groups still question whether this practice should be allowed to continue.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: for profit=이익을 위해 / for free=무료로 / for sale=판매용으로 / by force=강제로
det.analysis:
① for profit: 이익을 위해 분배? 정부는 이익 목적이 아니라고 함
② for free: 대부분의 고기·지방이 지역 사회에 '무료로' 분배되고, 대비로 일부만(although some) 판매(sold)됨 ←정답
③ for sale: 판매용으로 분배? 뒤의 '일부는 판매된다'와 중복·모순
④ by force: 강제로 분배? 문맥 없음
det.tip: distributed __________ ... although some is sold(일부만 판매) 대비 → for free(무료로)

questions.passage: Broken heart syndrome, also known as takotsubo syndrome (TTS), is a condition that occurs when stress weakens the heart's ability to pump blood. TTS can occur after stressful events such as the loss of a family member or a natural disaster. Surprisingly, researchers say people can also get TTS when happy things occur, sometimes referring to this as "happy heart syndrome." A researcher discovered this while analyzing data from 1,750 patients with takotsubo syndrome. Of the 485 patients diagnosed after emotional events, 20 had experienced happy events. The researcher concluded that the brain reacts similarly to extremely positive and negative events, so both can result in takotsubo syndrome.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 핵심: 긍정·부정 감정 둘 다 유발하는 심장 증후군
det.analysis:
① 심장병 예방 생활 습관: 예방법은 본문에 없음

② 자연재해가 인체에 주는 피해: 자연재해는 예시로만 언급

③ 행복한 일이 늘 심장에 좋은 이유: 오히려 행복한 일도 병을 유발하므로 반대

④ 긍정·부정 감정 모두가 유발하는 심장 증후군: 본문 전체 핵심 ←정답
det.tip: 긍정+부정 감정 둘 다 유발하는 심장 증후군이 주제

ch: 행복한 사건이 언제나 심장에 이로운 이유
긍정적·부정적 감정 모두가 유발할 수 있는 심장 증후군

questions.stem:
다음 우리말 뜻에 맞도록 주어진 단어를 모두 배열하여 문장을 완성하시오.

"고래고기와 지방은 중요한 부분이다." (7단어) (영어로) [조건] (1) and, are, blubber, important, meat, parts, whale 를 모두 사용 (2) 정확히 7단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: whale meat and blubber are important parts
det.analysis:
'고래고기와 지방'이 주어예요. 'whale meat(고래고기)'과 'blubber(지방)'를 and로 이어요: whale + meat + and + blubber.

주어가 둘(A and B)이라 복수이므로 be동사는 are를 써요: are.

'중요한 부분'은 important parts로 나타내요: important + parts.

순서대로 이으면 whale / meat / and / blubber / are / important / parts → 'whale meat and blubber are important parts'.
det.tip: A and B는 복수 → are / important parts = 중요한 부분

questions.wa: whale meat and blubber are important parts
accept: whale meat and blubber are important parts
blubber and whale meat are important parts

questions.stem:

questions.passage: Imagine you take your bicycle to a repair shop. You expect the workers at the shop to do what you paid them to do, which is to fix your bicycle. If they do a good job, you will be back again next time for bike repairs. If they do a bad job, however, you will look for a new repair shop. The same is true with governments. __________ to make sure that government does what is expected. If they do a good job, we can trust them in the future. If they don't, we can explain why we won't vote for them again. This kind of participation in government is important. How much effort we put into participating depends on how well we think the government is doing. If we are satisfied, we will do very little besides voting. But if we are dissatisfied, we will probably take other types of action.
questions.stem:

'그것은 시민으로서 우리의 일이다'
[조건] (1) It, is, our, job, as, citizens를 모두 사용
(2) 6단어로 쓸 것
(3) It으로 시작할 것

det.korean: It is our job as citizens = 그것은 시민으로서 우리의 일이다 (가주어 It)
det.analysis: 가주어 It + is + 보어(our job) + 자격을 나타내는 as citizens. 진주어는 뒤의 to make sure...절. 원문: 'It is our job as citizens to make sure ...'
det.tip: 가주어 It으로 시작 → It is our job as citizens (뒤에 to부정사 진주어)

questions.wa: It is our job as citizens

questions.passage: Dr. Viktor Emil Frankl was an Austrian psychiatrist who thought that feeling emotional pain was a natural part of life, and that __________ how to respond to situations. But most importantly, he believed that people's main motivation in life is the search for meaning. According to Frankl, in order to find this meaning in their lives, people have to change their attitude toward unavoidable suffering. For example, Frankl was helping a man who was severely depressed after his wife's death. He asked the man to think about what would have happened if he had died first and his wife had been forced to live without him. The man realized his own grief and pain meant that his wife did not have to experience what he was going through. This helped end his depression.
questions.stem:

[조건] (1) ability, choose, have, humans, the, to를 모두 사용

det.korean: humans have the ability to choose = 인간은 선택할 능력을 가지고 있다
det.analysis: humans(인간)+have(가지다)+the ability(능력)+to choose(선택할) = 6단어. 'the ability to choose'는 '선택할 능력'으로, 명사(ability)를 to부정사(to choose)가 뒤에서 꾸미는 구조
det.tip: 주어(humans)+동사(have)+목적어(the ability)+to부정사(to choose)

questions.wa: humans have the ability to choose
accept: humans have the ability to choose

questions.passage: Many products for sale at local supermarkets contain a chemical called bisphenol A, more commonly known as BPA. BPA can be found in plastics used to make food containers and baby bottles. It is also used to protect the inside of metal food cans. These products can cause people to be exposed to BPA through their diet. This is because BPA may leak out of these containers and into the food itself. BPA is harmful to the body because its structure is __________. This similarity makes it easy for vital bodily functions to be negatively affected. Whether or not BPA should be banned is controversial, but many experts consider it unwise to use products that contain BPA.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말과 같도록 [조건]에 맞게 영작하시오.
자연 호르몬의 그것과 유사한
[조건] (1) hormones, natural, of, similar, that, to를 모두 사용할 것
(2) 정확히 6단어로 쓸 것 (6단어)
(영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: similar to that of natural hormones (자연 호르몬의 그것(구조)과 유사한)
det.analysis:
먼저 'A와 유사한'은 similar to A로 써요.

여기서 A는 '자연 호르몬의 그것'이에요. 이때 that은 앞에 나온 명사 structure(구조)를 대신하는 대명사예요. 'that of ~'는 '~의 그것'이라는 뜻이에요.

① similar to(~와 유사한) → ② that(그것 = 구조) → ③ of natural hormones(자연 호르몬의).

완성: similar to that of natural hormones (6단어)
det.tip: that of ~ : 앞 명사의 반복을 피하는 '~의 그것'

questions.wa: similar to that of natural hormones
accept: similar to that of natural hormones
